name: checkin-bot
description: Sistema de automatización de check-in para aerolíneas

scripts.setup: npm run install-browsers && npm run setup:testing
scripts.setup:testing:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.env', 'LOG_LEVEL=info
LOG_CONSOLE=true
BROWSER_SLOW_MO=1000
BROWSER_HEADLESS=false
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=120000
MAX_RETRIES=3
DELAY_BETWEEN_PASSENGERS=10000
NODE_ENV=development')" && echo "✓ Modo TESTING activado (delays de 1s)"
scripts.setup:prod:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.env', 'LOG_LEVEL=info
LOG_CONSOLE=true
BROWSER_SLOW_MO=0
BROWSER_HEADLESS=false
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=60000
MAX_RETRIES=3
DELAY_BETWEEN_PASSENGERS=2000
NODE_ENV=production')" && echo "✓ Modo PRODUCCIÓN activado (máxima velocidad)"
scripts.clean: npm run clean:logs && npm run clean:pdfs
